notes: The national 112 line has operated since 23 Aug 2025 (Decree 200/2025/ND-CP), 24/7 and free from fixed and mobile phones. It is answered by the provincial military command for incidents, disasters and dangerous situations; calls within the scope of 113, 114 or 115 are passed to those lines. Source: https://xaydungchinhsach.chinhphu.vn/nhung-dieu-can-biet-ve-tong-dai-112-so-dien-thoai-tiep-nhan-thong-tin-va-noi-dung-thong-tin-ve-su-co-tham-hoa-119250714134442873.htm (Government portal), retrieved 2026-09-26.

Within the same area, dial 113, 114 or 115 directly without an area code. To get help for someone in another province, dial that province's area code first. Source: https://congan.dienbien.gov.vn/Danh-muc-tin-tuc/tong-hop-cac-so-dien-thoai-khan-cap-quoc-gia-ghi-nho-de-bao-ve-minh-va-ho-tro-nguoi-khac-13182.html (Dien Bien Provincial Police), retrieved 2026-09-26.
